description: This Java source file defines the LocationUtility class, which provides utility methods for managing and retrieving location information within the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods for obtaining default locations, handling global property changes, and caching default location data.

classes.name: LocationUtility
classes.description: A utility class for managing default and user-specific location information, implementing GlobalPropertyListener to respond to global property changes.

methods.name: getDefaultLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the system default location, utilizing caching and session check to optimize performance.

methods.name: getUserDefaultLocation
methods.description: Returns the default location associated with the current authenticated user.

methods.name: setDefaultLocation
methods.description: Sets the cached default location manually.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when a related global property changes, resetting cached values.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a related global property is deleted, resetting cached values.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Determines if the given property name is supported by this listener, based on a specific global property name constant.
